summary: Preserve every documented client error code during wire normalization

replay.detail: No historical claims or action receipts are changed.

schema.detail: All restored codes already belong to the client-v0 schema and generated clients.

rules.detail: Client-v0 normalization also preserves identity-cross-kind, identity-unknown, peer-too-old, invalid-document-reference and document-not-synced. A schema-derived guard prevents declared error codes from silently becoming internal.

compatibility.detail: Clients receive the documented error codes rather than internal; HTTP statuses and retryable classifications are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Existing error-specific client recovery rules apply.
